greet.speaker: ashfound_envoy
greet.text: Marshal Kade, Ashfound. I counted four machines and a mage on my way across your plaza, so I will be brief. We burn both. Magic, machine, the thing they made together. What is left is people. Will you hear the case?

choices.text: [Trueborn] You are preaching to the unaltered, Marshal.

piece.speaker: ashfound_envoy
piece.text: Every Shard you open feeds the fusion. Every machine you wake has a song in it now. When the Loom is found we put it out, all of it, and we start again smaller and honest. Your Synth would not survive that. I will not pretend otherwise.

choices.text: Then you have already lost me.
Kaj-7 knew the risks when it followed me.

answer.speaker: ashfound_envoy
answer.text: The offer is a forge and a straight answer. Keep the road open. Keep people alive. When the Loom is found, burn it. Until then we will trade with you, and we will not lie to you.

choices.text: Keep talking to us. That is all I promise.

warm.speaker: ashfound_envoy
warm.text: Good enough. Honest people keep talking.

cold.speaker: ashfound_envoy
cold.text: Noted. We do not need to be liked.

joined.speaker: ashfound_envoy
joined.text: Then the forge door is yours. Left of the yard gate. The armourer there sells things that do not sing.

answered.speaker: ashfound_envoy
answered.text: You gave me an answer. I do not need another one.

locked.speaker: ashfound_envoy
locked.text: You picked a side. Fine. We will see you at the Loom.
